coverage_broad.explantion: Both responses suffer from the same high‑severity flaws—narrow focus, missing major aspects, and lack of context—but response b includes a few additional elements (discussion of systemic challenges, an industry example, and directories) that broaden the view beyond merely listing corporate initiatives. consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses suffer from the same fatal flaws: blurred viewpoints/conflation (mixing distinct initiatives like CBS diversity targets, Endeavor Content policies, and Comcast RISE grants), attribution failures (statements are not explicitly tied to their sources), and false consensus (presenting progress as universally accepted).
